items.title: LifeVal: Measuring Personal-Assistant Progress on Everyday Tasks
items.snippet: OpenAI released LifeVal, a new benchmark designed to measure model progress on tasks that matter in everyday life, moving beyond traditional knowledge or academic benchmarks. It focuses on scenarios like parenting, accessing government services, budgeting, and designing fitness plans. The goal is to evaluate AI assistants on their ability to take action and complete work, not just offer advice.

items.title: Community Safety Report and New Protections for Teens
items.snippet: OpenAI has announced a major expansion of its safety architecture, specifically focusing on violence prevention and early intervention for teen users interacting with ChatGPT. The system now evaluates conversational trajectories over multiple turns to detect self-harm, severe psychological distress, or escalating violent tendencies. Interventions include adjusting model tone and providing crisis hotline resources.

items.title: Genie 4: A New Generation of World Simulation
items.snippet: Google DeepMind has published details on Genie 4, a new iteration of its Genie world model, which simulates people and environments with greater realism. This version offers improved simulation of complex events, more natural character movement, and interactive steering in real-time. Genie 4 also integrates Gemini 3.8 Flash as a guiding agent for continuous calibration and adaptive planning.

items.title: Antigravity Cheminformatics Skills — AI agent for drug-design analysis
items.snippet: Antigravity Cheminformatics Skills are a set of agent skills for Google Antigravity that enable an AI agent to collect, curate, and analyze compound data from literature and patents for drug design. The model plans the work and reasons about results, while deterministic chemistry tools built on RDKit perform the actual calculations. This approach significantly reduces the time from proposal to design, from days to about an hour.

items.title: AlphaEarth Foundations: Integrating Petabytes of Earth Observation Data
items.snippet: Google DeepMind's AlphaEarth Foundations introduces an AI model that integrates petabytes of Earth observation data into a unified representation. This model enables various applications, including unsupervised and supervised classification of landscapes, regression for predicting environmental variables like canopy height, and similarity search for identifying similar surface conditions globally. The project provides a comprehensive dataset and tutorials for developers.

items.title: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
items.snippet: CWE-bench v2 offers enhanced coverage, quality, and transparency for evaluating code generation models on security vulnerabilities. The updated benchmark includes 100 tasks covering 91 different Common Weakness Enumerations (CWEs) and employs LLM judge panels for curation. Gemini 4 Argon leads the evaluated models with 67.8% pass@1 and 81.0% pass@4.

items.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.snippet: The 'CUA-Master' paper presents a method for scaling computer-use agents through open-world recursive improvements. This research aims to enhance the autonomy and capabilities of AI agents by allowing them to continuously learn and improve in dynamic, unconstrained environments. It addresses challenges in real-world application and agent generalization.

items.title: CoworkOS: Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
items.snippet: The 'CoworkOS' paper introduces a system for scaling agent coworkers to achieve real-world automation. This work focuses on developing frameworks and methodologies for multiple AI agents to collaborate effectively on complex tasks. It addresses orchestration, task division, and communication challenges in multi-agent systems for practical applications.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.snippet: This paper explores the intersection of 'Video Generation Meets Agent Harness', detailing agentic video generation, agentic world modeling, and recursive self-improvement. It investigates how AI agents can autonomously create and refine video content, including simulating dynamic virtual worlds, through continuous learning and iterative enhancements.

items.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
items.snippet: 'SWE-Trail' introduces a method for history-guided trajectory collection specifically for training coding agents. This research focuses on accumulating valuable interaction data to improve the performance of AI agents in software engineering tasks. By analyzing past successful and unsuccessful trajectories, the system enhances learning for code generation and debugging.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.snippet: The 'NorthCUA Technical Report' details how computer-use agents can be turbocharged through experience at scale. This report investigates methods for rapidly improving the efficiency and effectiveness of AI agents by exposing them to vast amounts of operational data and real-world scenarios, leading to significant performance gains in diverse tasks.

items.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
items.snippet: 'Lost in Recovery' demystifies the recovery behavior of computer-use agents through goal-oriented action replay. This paper analyzes how AI agents recover from errors or unexpected situations by replaying and learning from past successful recovery strategies. It aims to improve the robustness and resilience of autonomous agents in complex computational environments.
related_to: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements

items.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360 Degree View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
items.snippet: 'PhotoGuider' presents a system for composition-aware cropping and 360-degree view framing, complemented by explainable photographic assessments. This research uses AI to understand and apply principles of good photographic composition, offering automated tools for image enhancement and virtual reality content creation, with transparent reasoning for its decisions.

items.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
items.snippet: 'Reviso' investigates the selective attention of visual evidence in video captioning, proposing that not all visual information is equally important. This paper introduces a mechanism to dynamically weight visual cues, allowing AI models to focus on the most salient aspects of a video when generating descriptive captions, leading to more accurate and concise summaries.

items.title: Rebuild 2026-11-01: AWQ fixes (MoE router/shared-expert-gate compensated during smoothing; gemma basic-pipeline smoothing actually applied), un-smoothed norms bit-exact
items.snippet: This update details AWQ fixes, including compensation for MoE router/shared-expert-gate during smoothing and the actual application of gemma basic-pipeline smoothing. It also addresses un-smoothed norms to be bit-exact. These technical improvements are crucial for the efficient and accurate deployment of large language models, particularly those with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures.

items.title: XLSR-Conformer-TCM-DF — implementation notes
items.snippet: These implementation notes provide a detailed overview of the XLSR-Conformer-TCM-DF model for speech spoofing detection. They cover the model's architecture, hyper-parameters, and wrapper decisions, including input processing and scoring mechanisms. The document also highlights specific optimizations and findings related to TF32 precision and batch-size overrides.

items.title: Prepare web content for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with Crawl4AI
items.snippet: This article demonstrates using Crawl4AI, an open-source Python crawler, to prepare web content for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. It focuses on custom extraction, Markdown formatting, and metadata sidecars for improved retrieval quality and citation accuracy in RAG applications. The workflow outlines deploying a scheduled AWS Fargate task to crawl websites and upload prepared content to Amazon S3.

items.title: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock
items.snippet: Circle K reduced DevOps incident triage time to under 15 minutes using Amazon Bedrock, decreasing manual investigation by 67-75 percent. They built an automated triage system with Amazon Bedrock Flows and Knowledge Bases, initially using three specialized agents. The system delivers structured incident summaries to Slack rapidly, enhancing incident response.

items.title: JustVugg / colibri
items.snippet: Colibri is a hierarchical inference engine for frontier Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, designed for efficient execution on consumer hardware. It manages hot experts on the GPU, warm ones in RAM, and cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, it aims to optimize performance for large language models.

items.title: Donchitos / Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.snippet: This repository presents a framework to 'Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio,' featuring 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system. It mirrors a real studio hierarchy to enable complex game development tasks. The project aims to automate and streamline various aspects of game creation using AI.

items.title: Usagi-org / ai-goofish-monitor
items.snippet: AI Goofish Monitor is a system based on Playwright and AI for real-time/timed monitoring and intelligent analysis of multi-task processes, equipped with a comprehensive backend management UI. It helps users find desired products from a large volume of items, implying applications in e-commerce or data scraping.

items.title: huggingface/optimum
items.snippet: Hugging Face's Optimum project provides easy-to-use hardware optimization tools to accelerate inference and training of Transformers, Diffusers, TIMM, and Sentence Transformers. It offers methods to enhance the performance of various machine learning models across different hardware configurations, crucial for efficient deployment and research.

items.title: weideyouni/holoaeon
items.snippet: Holoaeon describes a multi-agent framework with an 'AdaptiveGraph' for collaboration, supporting features like Dijkstra shortest path, load application, and root-cause analysis. It includes 25 agents, 47 skills, and 9 domain packs, with recent updates focusing on 'Cold-hot-plug empowerment' and evidence hardening.

items.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
items.snippet: A post discusses how a frontier LLM, GPT-6 Astra, can read and edit network weights of other models like Qwen without a traditional training loop. This novel approach suggests AI models gaining the capability to understand and directly modify the underlying parameters of other neural networks, indicating a leap in model introspection and self-modification.

dropped.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
dropped.snippet: OpenAI introduces the Grid Protectors Program, which will work with utilities, regulators, and policymakers so future compute campuses can support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs. The program aims to lower electricity demand when the grid is under stress, ensuring that households and small businesses are not burdened by the power needs of compute facilities. A pilot program in Effingham, Georgia, is designed to free up to 1,000 megawatts of flexible demand response.

dropped.title: OpenAI Model Spec Update: Core Values and Principles
dropped.snippet: OpenAI's updated Model Spec outlines five core values: Be faithful to human intent, Minimize harm, Be honest and transparent, Facilitate human agency, and Act with care. The document details how the model should behave, including principles against misleading users unless explicitly directed by a higher authority. It emphasizes preserving user control while striving for beneficial outcomes.

dropped.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
dropped.snippet: This paper introduces 'Wave Forcing', a novel approach towards achieving speed-of-light streaming video generation. The research explores new methods for efficient video synthesis, focusing on low-latency and high-throughput performance. This could have significant implications for real-time video applications and interactive media.

dropped.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
dropped.snippet: This paper highlights recent 'Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics', exploring how AI agents are being integrated into graphic design and rendering pipelines. The research delves into new paradigms for creating and manipulating visual content using autonomous agents, potentially revolutionizing areas like animation, game development, and architectural visualization.

dropped.title: Show HN: Subvocal – Talk to your computer without making noise
dropped.snippet: Subvocal is a new project that allows users to communicate with their computer silently, without vocalizing. This innovation could enable more discreet and efficient human-computer interaction, with potential applications in various environments where spoken commands are impractical or undesirable. The project is presented as a 'Show HN' demonstrating its capabilities.

dropped.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
dropped.snippet: The paper 'Democratizing Robot-Use Agents' proposes a unified harness that leverages open models to make robot control more accessible. This research aims to lower the barrier to entry for developing and deploying robotic agents by providing a standardized framework and utilizing publicly available AI models. It covers aspects of control, perception, and task execution.
